note.summary: Skiers and snowboarders share why they love Blue Mountain Resort, highlighting its runs, scenery, and community. It is an advertisement for Blue Mountain Resort.
note.hook: An aerial shot of a snowy mountain with ski slopes and ski lifts.
note.voiceover: I've been a season pass holder here for eight years, but I've been skiing here for 30 years. I love Blue Mountain because it has a lot of good runs, it has a lot of challenging runs, and it has a lot of runs that I'm capable of doing and having fun on. Love that all my friends work here at the mountain, and it's a beautiful place to come and ski and have fun. Amount of trails, diversity, and just the camaraderie and life-long friends here. I love the trails. Just love the scenery. It's a great place to snowboard. The snow is pretty much always great whenever we come out here. It's just pretty much perfect for me. The mountain, I love the quietness. I love the the people seem a lot more calmer on the mountain.
note.music: Upbeat acoustic and electric guitar music
